Link

Matters because: this highlights sidechain and bridge security risk rather than BTC L1 risk, and could pressure confidence in Liquid-based products until funds are recovered or clarified.

Security/Exploits.text:
Harmony proposes shutting down mainnet, migrating ONE token to Ethereum –
Link
Citing severe security threats, including an August exploit that minted ≈4B unauthorized ONE tokens, the Harmony team proposed fully discontinuing its L1. The plan would airdrop replacement tokens to ONE holders on Ethereum via snapshot, and users must exit smart contracts by Sept. 10, 2026.
Matters because: this shows continued consolidation pressure on smaller legacy L1s facing recurring security incidents.

Chilean exchange Orionx suspends withdrawals, winds down after $7M+ shortfall –
Link
A forensic audit found over $7M in customer assets moved to uncontrolled wallets. Orionx has filed criminal charges against its founders, and over 100,000 users may not recover funds in full.
Matters because: it reinforces the counterparty risk of unregulated regional exchanges and may push users toward more regulated venues.

Liquid network (Bitcoin sidechain) hacked for ≈$320M via consensus bug –
Link
An Elements protocol consensus/asset-validation bug let an attacker mint ≈4,000 unbacked L-BTC and drain ≈3,996 BTC via SideSwap's peg-out flow on Sept. 6-7. The attacker claims to be a "whitehat," but funds remain unreturned; Bitcoin mainnet itself was not exploited.
Matters because: this highlights sidechain and bridge security risk rather than BTC L1 risk, and could pressure confidence in Liquid-based products until funds are recovered or clarified.

Liquid Network hit by $320M exploit, transactions halted –
Link
A Bitcoin sidechain settlement layer used by several exchanges, Blockstream's Liquid Network, was drained of roughly 4,000 BTC (≈$320M) by attackers claiming to be "white hats." The network has been fully paused.
Matters because: The exploit adds to a recent run of major crypto hacks and could weigh on confidence in Bitcoin-adjacent infrastructure, even if the damage has been contained to the sidechain rather than BTC spot.
